description: This Scala source file defines extension methods for DStream of key-value pairs in Apache Spark Streaming, providing functions like groupByKey, reduceByKey, join, cogroup, and windowed operations, along with Hadoop output capabilities.

classes.name: PairDStreamFunctions
classes.description: Provides additional functions for DStream of (key, value) pairs, including grouping, reducing, joining, windowed operations, and Hadoop file output.

methods.name: groupByKey
methods.description: Returns a new DStream by applying groupByKey to each RDD, with optional partitioning control.

methods.name: reduceByKey
methods.description: Returns a new DStream by applying reduceByKey to each RDD, merging values with an associative reduce function.

methods.name: combineByKey
methods.description: Combines elements of each key in DStream's RDDs using custom create, merge, and combine functions.

methods.name: groupByKeyAndWindow
methods.description: Applies groupByKey over a sliding window with specified window and slide durations.

methods.name: reduceByKeyAndWindow
methods.description: Applies reduceByKey over a sliding window with specified window and slide durations, with optional inverse reduce for efficiency.

methods.name: mapWithState
methods.description: Creates a MapWithStateDStream to maintain and update state per key using a specified StateSpec.

methods.name: updateStateByKey
methods.description: Updates the state for each key using a specified update function, with options for partitioning and initial state.

methods.name: mapValues
methods.description: Transforms the values of each key-value pair without changing the key.

methods.name: flatMapValues
methods.description: FlatMaps the values of each key-value pair without changing the key.

methods.name: cogroup
methods.description: Performs cogroup operation with another DStream of key-value pairs.

methods.name: join
methods.description: Joins with another DStream of key-value pairs.

methods.name: leftOuterJoin
methods.description: Performs a left outer join with another DStream.

methods.name: rightOuterJoin
methods.description: Performs a right outer join with another DStream.

methods.name: fullOuterJoin
methods.description: Performs a full outer join with another DStream.

methods.name: saveAsHadoopFiles
methods.description: Saves each RDD in the DStream as Hadoop files with specified prefix, suffix, and output format.

methods.name: saveAsNewAPIHadoopFiles
methods.description: Saves each RDD in the DStream as Hadoop files using the new Hadoop API.
